name: footer-blocks
title: Footer Blocks
description: One footer component with four layouts. It can show a mega sitemap with region and language pickers, a searchable page index, a contact card with a live clock, or a slim link bar.
use: A product site wants several footer styles for different page types, all from one import.
avoid: You need a tiny single-row footer; the search and contact variants add behaviour and height.
a11y: Strong: nav labels, aria-labelled select inputs and focus rings; the sitemap animation respects reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark, full-width footer with a brand wordmark and tagline at the top, a four-column sitemap of small headings and links, and a bottom bar of legal links, social marks and two pill selectors. Other variants swap the body for a search field or contact rows.
behaves: A variant pill changes the whole layout. The sitemap columns rise in as they scroll into view, the link-search footer filters every page as you type, and the contact footer copies rows beside a live clock.
customise: FooterBlocks takes only variant, brand and className; link data comes from kit constants. Use the four exported sub-footers to pass your own columns, links and socials.
weight: light: Static links with small CSS transitions; the search and clock add minor client work.
